# N12: Held at company size: 15,000 people, 1,500 teams and 30,000 goals; no select of everything, pickers within 200 ms, list bars within 300 ms (N12)

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/11-company-size.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured.

## What it checks

N12 (docs/design/find/spec.md, section 7; FS4): held at company size. In a generated workspace of 15,000 people, 1,500 teams and 30,000 goals (evals/fixtures/company.cjs): no <select> anywhere has more than 25 options; every picker shows its first results within 200 ms of a key and draws at most 50 rows; every list bar answers a search within 300 ms (its 150 ms pause for typing included). Find from anywhere joins this check when it lands (FS3): it isn't built yet, so there is nothing to time. The workspace opens once (it takes a while: the browser adapter reads every goal; the internal app's server pages it, R4) and the pages are visited inside the app, so each page is measured, not the load. Times are the median of three keys, measured from the key to the words that answer it, against budgets scaled for a slower machine (below).

## What it reports as wrong

- {path}: a select has {most} options
- {path}: the list bar answers a search in {ms} ms ({times.join(', ')}), not within {LIST_MS}{at.replace('{b}', String(listMs))}
- {path}: a picker draws {rows} rows for “{w}”
- {path}: a picker shows what “{words.join('”, “')}” found in {ms} ms ({times.join(', ')}), not within {PICKER_MS}{at.replace('{b}', String(pickerMs))}
- stopped: {String(e.message || e).split('\n')[0]}
